Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is
consistent with the shoulder injury described, and the force involved appears to match the pattern of soft tissue and joint findings
documented on examination. Over seven visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, graded
range-of-motion exercises, and a home program. Treatment extended somewhat beyond the course typically seen for this type of
injury, reflecting a slower functional recovery. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury. The patient
also has a history of treatment to the same shoulder region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to
contribute to some of the current complaints. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same
services.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
